name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
role: U.S. Representative for New York's 14th district (2019-present); member of the Democratic Socialists of America
summary: Ocasio-Cortez is a progressive Democrat and self-described democratic socialist whose record centers on Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, a federal jobs guarantee, tuition-free college and student debt cancellation, and higher taxes on top incomes. She has also called for criminal justice reform, abolishing ICE, reducing military spending and protecting abortion and LGBTQ rights. She has said she rejects state socialism and favors worker cooperatives and democratic participation, and her foreign-policy record is mostly anti-war with recent support for Ukraine.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Her 2018 platform calls Improved and Expanded Medicare for All the path to guarantee no one goes without care, and she endorsed H.R. 676; H.Res.109 lists high-quality health care for all.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Backs a $15 federal minimum wage pegged to inflation (platform) and returned to bartending in 2019 to promote the Raise the Wage Act, which would end the $2.13 tipped wage.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Proposed a marginal rate as high as 70% on income above $10 million and wants the Social Security payroll cap lifted for incomes above $250,000.

unions-good.rationale: H.Res.109 calls for strengthening the right of all workers to organize, unionize and bargain collectively; she skipped Biden's inauguration to join a Bronx strike.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Platform proposes restoring Glass-Steagall and breaking up too-big-to-fail banks; H.Res.109 calls for strengthened labor and standards enforcement; she joined an FTC chair roundtable on checking corporate power.

cut-welfare.rationale: Opposes Medicaid cuts, wants Social Security and Medicaid expanded, and her 'A Just Society' package would widen access to social welfare programs.

worker-ownership.rationale: Supports worker cooperatives as a model (cited as compatible with free markets) and H.Res.109 names worker cooperatives as partners; she does not say all firms should be worker-owned.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Platform supports federal legalization of marijuana and ending the war on drugs; she has also sponsored legislation easing psilocybin research. No broader stance on all recreational drugs found.

state-harmful.rationale: Her record is of proposing large public programs (Medicare for All, Green New Deal, public housing, jobs guarantee); she also criticizes state socialism but never argues the state itself is unnecessary.

limit-guns.rationale: Platform calls for reinstating a permanent assault weapons ban, banning high-capacity magazines and bump stocks, universal background checks and surrender of firearms by abusers; it stays within the Second Amendment.

empower-police-military.rationale: Calls for reducing defense spending, voted against a 2022 omnibus for funding defense and immigration agencies, and argues for cutting police budgets in favor of social programs.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Platform opposes criminalization of sex work, and she has said decriminalization 'should happen' while urging care in how it is done.

rehabilitation.rationale: In her America essay she asks whether sentencing aims at punishment or rehabilitation and urges 'an aim to rehabilitate our brothers and sisters wherever possible'.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Led House progressives in 2022 to protect marriage equality from being revisited after Dobbs and describes herself as a proponent of LGBTQ equality.

abortion-legal.rationale: Platform asks for 'open access to safe, legal, affordable abortion' and she supports codifying the right to abortion; she was arrested protesting Dobbs.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: H.Res.109 aims at 'repairing historic oppression' of communities of color and indigenous peoples; her platform ties mass incarceration to Jim Crow and calls for remedies.

gradual-change.rationale: Calls for 10-year mobilization, abolishing ICE, expanding the Supreme Court and says she will not compromise her values for consensus; she expects economic change 'of an unprecedented degree'.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Platform calls for clearing a path to citizenship and abolishing ICE; she told PBS immigrants are an economic source rather than a burden; cosponsored the New Way Forward Act; none of this is about overall immigration levels.

free-trade.rationale: H.Res.109 calls for trade rules, procurement standards and border adjustments with labor and environmental protections to stop job and pollution transfer overseas.

nation-first.rationale: H.Res.109 aims to help other countries achieve a Green New Deal and her platform favors diplomatic and economic ties over military engagement, though she frames it as strengthening the U.S.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Introduced H.Res.109 for a 10-year national mobilization to net-zero emissions; platform calls for 100% renewable energy by 2035 and climate change the biggest national security threat.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Has said she has an open mind about nuclear power's role in a Green New Deal, without clearly endorsing or opposing expansion.

central-planning.rationale: Has rejected state socialism as 'undemocratic' and 'easily corrupted', and cites cooperatives within free-market economies as her model.

socialized-markets.rationale: Argues free-market economies and democratic socialism are compatible, pointing to worker cooperatives as the model.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: H.Res.109 supports border adjustments and trade rules 'to grow domestic manufacturing in the United States'; she has not been recorded calling for general tariffs.

state-directs-investment.rationale: H.Res.109 envisions public financing, public banks and directed investment toward clean industry and deindustrialized communities, with public ownership stakes.

military-superiority.rationale: Platform criticizes a new arms race 'nobody can win' and huge fighter-jet and nuclear modernization programs; she calls for reduced defense spending.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: H.Res.109 calls for free, prior and informed consent on decisions affecting indigenous territories and for protecting and enforcing indigenous sovereignty and land rights.

direct-action.rationale: She emphasizes winning elections and Congress while also organizing outside the chamber; she took part in civil disobedience (2022 arrest) but not as a replacement for elections.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Told PBS that people who create value in society are not receiving any portion of it, and called a $2.13 tipped wage 'indentured servitude'; she does not endorse a general theory of exploitation.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Has called state socialism undemocratic and stresses that democratic socialism means everyone votes.

taxation-theft.rationale: Advocates much higher taxes on top incomes and corporations to fund Medicare for All, free college and the Green New Deal, treating tax revenue as legitimate public funding.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Told PBS 'I believe absolutely in Israel's right to exist' and supports a two-state solution; she has since sharply criticized Israeli policy but not renounced this.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Voted against the PAYGO rule and argued the Green New Deal needs deficit spending like the New Deal; voted against the 2023 Fiscal Responsibility Act.

national-self-determination.rationale: Co-led the Puerto Rico Self-Determination Act and said at Munich that no nation's sovereignty should be violated by Russia.

force-without-un.rationale: Platform criticizes military action taken unilaterally without UN backing and without a congressional vote.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Her 'A Just Society' proposal would ensure access to welfare programs for undocumented immigrants.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Opposed Medicaid work requirements in a House hearing, citing patients facing miscarriages and medical emergencies.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Platform demands equal pay, workplace safety and equal access for all genders and calls for ending structural impediments for women.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Platform condemns Jim Crow and redlining as policies rooted in the marginalization of African Americans, and H.Res.109 calls for repairing their legacy.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Platform commits to a 100% fossil-free economy by 2035 and H.Res.109 calls for clean, zero-emission power.

national-mission.rationale: Platform says America 'should not be in the business of destabilizing countries' and warns that the world sees it as occupier and aggressor.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: H.Res.109 lists the gender earnings gap among 'systemic injustices', and her platform speaks of structural impediments women face.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Platform attacks corporate money and lobbyists corrupting legislators; she co-founded the End Corruption Caucus in 2026 and argues no rules stop lawmakers being bought by corporations.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Platform calls for automatic independent investigations each time law enforcement kills someone and condemns ICE as unaccountable to Congress.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Proposals include Medicare for All, a jobs guarantee, public housing and free college, all far beyond a minimal state.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Platform says all people are owed dignity and respect regardless of citizenship, and she states trans rights are human rights.

priority-to-poor.rationale: H.Res.109 prioritizes frontline communities including the poor; she told PBS her democratic socialism means no person in America should be too poor to live.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: H.Res.109 supports organizing and bargaining 'free of coercion, intimidation, and harassment' and she joined the Hunts Point strike.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: H.Res.109 attributes poverty and inequality to wage stagnation, deindustrialization and antilabor policy, not population growth.

party-controls-media.rationale: Co-signed letters criticizing Chinese censorship of Hong Kong protesters and urging American companies to support freedom of speech.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Supported pay raises for members of Congress in 2019, arguing all workers deserve cost-of-living increases.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Platform wants troops home from the 'forever war', but she has since criticized the Trump administration for weak commitment to Ukraine and European allies.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Platform opposes rollbacks of access to 'medically accurate sexuality education' and supports gender equality education.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Introduced the Ukraine Comprehensive Debt Payment Relief Act and called for cancelling Puerto Rico's Wall Street debt.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Platform criticizes the $1.7 trillion nuclear weapons modernization program and a new arms race.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Supports a two-state solution and opposes the occupation of the West Bank and expanding settlements.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Opposes the occupation of the West Bank and said Russia should not be rewarded for violating Ukrainian sovereignty.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Backs steeply progressive rates, up to 70% above $10 million, rather than a flat tax.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Supported impeaching Trump twice, saying 'no person is above that law'.

women-must-cover.rationale: Supported Mahsa Amini protesters, saying the right to choose belongs to us all, 'from hijabs to reproductive care'.

ban-cartels.rationale: H.Res.109 calls for a commercial environment free from domination by monopolies; her platform backs breaking up oversized banks, and she backed FTC chair Lina Khan.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: H.Res.109 calls for trade rules with strong labor and environmental protections.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Endorsed the Equality Act and H.Res.109 calls for enforcing antidiscrimination standards across all employers.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Platform calls for expanding Social Security and lifting its payroll cap, not replacing it with private accounts.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Platform opposes destabilizing foreign governments and ending America's involvement in wars across the Middle East.

corporate-influence.rationale: Platform calls the Citizens United ruling an invitation to buy government with dark money and pledges to refuse lobbyist and corporate PAC money.

job-guarantee.rationale: Platform endorses a federal jobs guarantee with $15 wage and healthcare; H.Res.109 calls for a guaranteed family-sustaining job.

treaties-binding.rationale: H.Res.109 calls for honoring all treaties and agreements with indigenous peoples.

holocaust-denial.rationale: In 2019 she distinguished concentration camps from death camps and discussed the Holocaust in that context.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Endorsed the Equality Act and the Every Child Deserves a Family Act, and describes herself as a proponent of LGBTQ rights.

participatory-democracy.rationale: H.Res.109 and her public housing bill require democratic, participatory processes led by communities and workers, including resident approval of plans.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Platform says LGBTQ issues are 'not isolated' from race and class, and H.Res.109 treats racial, social and economic injustices as linked systemic injustices.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Platform backs the Equality Act and criticizes anti-trans rollbacks; she has said 'Trans rights are civil rights are human rights'.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Platform endorses the Arbitration Fairness Act and calls for ending arbitration clauses that shield corporate abuses.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Platform wants forces kept for when they are 'truly needed' and she supports Ukraine aid, not abolishing the military.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Platform says Citizens United let the wealthy purchase the government, and she warns about oligarchy; H.Res.109 cites the greatest inequality since the 1920s.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Platform criticizes the effort to remove trans people from military service and defends LGBTQ rights.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Seeks cuts to police budgets and ending private prisons and mass incarceration, but not abolition of all police and prisons.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Her platform relies on government programs like Medicare for All and Social Security to meet basic needs, not private charity.

rent-control.rationale: Her 'A Just Society' proposal would cap annual rent increases.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Platform wants armed forces kept 'only for when they're truly needed', ending forever wars and unauthorized strikes.

free-public-college.rationale: Platform and PBS interview call for tuition-free public colleges and trade schools.

future-generations.rationale: H.Res.109 aims to secure clean air, water and a sustainable environment 'for generations to come'.

arms-reduction.rationale: Calls for cutting the Pentagon budget and criticizes the arms race.

collective-bargaining.rationale: H.Res.109 calls for strengthening workers' right to organize and bargain collectively.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Opposed and voted against the PAYGO rule that requires deficit-neutral policy.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Platform supports one-time federal student debt cancellation and she has said she wants all student debt cancelled.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Her America essay lists reconsidering mandatory minimum sentencing among the reforms to pursue.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Platform wants an end to the war on drugs and independent investigations into every killing by law enforcement.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Backs universal programs: Medicare for All, free public college and a job guarantee, rather than poverty-targeted ones.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Opposed New York's $3 billion subsidy package for Amazon and H.Res.109 calls for freedom from monopoly domination.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: H.Res.109 cites a racial wealth gap and systemic racial injustice, and her platform ties mass incarceration to historical racism.

notes: Fresh audit that replaces an older pilot. Only positions shown in bills she sponsored, votes, her platform or her own words are recorded; the rest is left null. Her views on Israel changed: she affirmed Israel's right to exist and a two-state solution in 2018 and later called Gaza a genocide and backed arms limits; the 2018 right-to-exist answer is kept at medium confidence because she has not renounced it. On ICE she moved from 'abolish' (2018) toward decriminalizing entry and restructuring enforcement. The Wikipedia source is used for votes and later statements that were not available as primary full text.
